ORDER BY cp.update_time DESC, cp.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT cp.id AS id, cp.slug AS slug, cp.post_type AS postType, cp.title AS title, IFNULL(cp.summary, '') AS summary, cp.reading_minutes AS readingMinutes, IFNULL(cp.cover_url, '') AS coverUrl, IFNULL(cp.cover_tone, '') AS coverTone, cp.content AS content, cp.author_id AS authorId, cp.board_id AS boardId, cp.category_id AS categoryId, cp.column_id AS columnId, cp.publish_status AS publishStatus, cp.visibility AS visibility, cp.is_top AS isTop, cp.is_featured AS isFeatured, cp.ranking AS ranking FROM content_post cp WHERE cp.id = #{id} AND cp.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
